$comment: Ships and orders (scripts/game/trade.js). A ship sails in over water to a pier, docks, shows ONE order (goods the town hands over for coins), waits until its deadline and leaves; a filled order pays and raises the reputation, a missed one lowers it. Days are game days (data/economy.json calendar: 10 per season). schedule: firstShipDays = days after the game starts (or after the first pier) before the first ship is sent; gapDays [min, max] between two ships; orderDays [min, max] = days a ship waits at the pier. reputation: start, max, filled / missed = the change, earlyBonus = extra when the order is filled with at least half of its days left. sailSpeed = cells per game second on the water. classes: minReputation to be sent, weight in the random pick, wants = per good [min, max] amount, goods = [min, max] kinds of good in one order, premium = multiplier on the goods' base prices (the reward, rounded to 5). The ship's name is one of the locale strings ship.name.0 .. ship.name.<nameCount - 1>.
